mapping_path <- "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv"

get_theme <- function(category_name) {
  if (category_name %in% names(theme_codes)) {
    unique(theme_codes[[category_name]])
  } else {
    character()
  }
}

```{r}


std_study <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_remove(x, '[_]\\w+|:')  # CHECK: ensure this collapse is intended
}
# UNIT CONVERSION (2026-08-11, CODE_AUDIT_2026-08-11.md section 1.1).
# The local to_ng_per_mL() removed here ended in `TRUE ~ value`, so mg/dL,
# ug/mL, ng/g, pmol/mL, nM and kg/m3 fell through UNCONVERTED and were treated
# as ng/mL -- 39,475 rows (5.9%), wrong by factors of 10^3 to 10^6.
local({
  cands <- c("../harmonization_helpers.R", "harmonization_helpers.R",
             "Coding/Paper1_Submission2/harmonization_helpers.R")
  hit <- cands[file.exists(cands)]
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("Cannot locate harmonization_helpers.R")
  source(hit[[1]], local = FALSE)
})
Child_Data_Targeted <- Targeted_Data_All %>%
  filter(!is.na(Child_PID)) %>%                           # keep child samples
  mutate(
    Units = if_else(is.na(Units), "ng/mL", Units),        # default units
    Concentration = to_ng_per_mL(Concentration, Units)    # normalize units
  ) %>%
  select(-Mat_PID) %>%                                    # not needed for child
  filter(!is.na(Analyte_Code)) %>%                        # require analyte code
  group_by(Study, Child_PID, Analyte_Code) %>%            # average replicates
  summarise(Concentration = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

child_analytes <- sort(unique(Child_Data_Targeted$Analyte_Code))  # vector of analytes

# Build a list of per-analyte wide data.frames keyed by Child_PID ---------
child_list_Targeted <- purrr::map(
  child_analytes,
  ~ Child_Data_Targeted %>%
    filter(Analyte_Code == .x) %>%                         # one analyte
    mutate(Study = std_study(Study)) %>%                   # standardize label
    select(Study, Child_PID, Analyte_Code, Concentration) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Analyte_Code, values_from = Concentration) %>%
    select(Child_PID, Study, all_of(.x))                   # only current analyte col
) %>%
  rlang::set_names(child_analytes)

# MATERNAL targeted data: long -> wide per-analyte list -------------------
Mat_Data_Targeted <- Targeted_Data_All %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mat_PID)) %>%                              # keep maternal samples
  select(-Child_PID) %>%
  mutate(
    Units = if_else(is.na(Units), "ng/mL", Units),
    Concentration = to_ng_per_mL(Concentration, Units)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Analyte_Code)) %>%
  group_by(Study, Mat_PID, Analyte_Code) %>%
  summarise(Concentration = mean(Concentration, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace(., is.infinite(.), NA_real_)))  

mat_analytes <- sort(unique(Mat_Data_Targeted$Analyte_Code))

mat_list_Targeted <- purrr::map(
  mat_analytes,
  ~ Mat_Data_Targeted %>%
    filter(Analyte_Code == .x) %>%
    mutate(Study = std_study(Study)) %>%
    select(Study, Mat_PID, Analyte_Code, Concentration) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Analyte_Code, values_from = Concentration) %>%
    select(Mat_PID, Study, all_of(.x))
) %>%
  rlang::set_names(mat_analytes)

```

```{r}
Fast_Merge <- function(mylist = All_Perc,ID_Col = "Child_PID"){
  

  results_df <- mylist[[1]] %>% 
   dplyr::select(-any_of("Units")) %>% 
   group_by(!!sym(ID_Col),Study) %>% 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
    ungroup()
    #summarise(value = mean(col_name,na.rm = T))
  

  for(i in 2:length(mylist)){
    
    #print(i)
    
    curr_df <- mylist[[i]] %>% 
   dplyr::select(-any_of("Units")) %>% 
      group_by(!!sym(ID_Col),Study) %>% 
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
    ungroup()
    
    #names(curr_df) <- c(ID_Col,"Study",metab_new)
    results_df <- full_join(results_df, curr_df, by = c(ID_Col,"Study"))

  }
  
  return(results_df)  
}

```

```{r}
Ref_Vars <- c("Child_PID" ,"Study","Mat_PID","Mat_Age","Mat_Edu","Mat_Income", "Max_Edu","Child_Age","Mat_Race","Child_Race","Child_Sex")

mystudies <- unique(Child_SDOH_Exp$Study)
All_PCA_Data <- list()
for(i in seq_along(mystudies)){
  
  curr_study <- mystudies[[i]]
  
  curr_data <- Child_SDOH_Exp %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Study == curr_study) %>% 
    select_if(~ !all(is.na(.))) %>% 
    mutate(.rowid = row_number())

  mycols <- names(curr_data)
  mycols <- mycols[!mycols %in% Ref_Vars]
  
  pca_data <-curr_data %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(mycols)) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

  
  pca_obj <- prcomp(pca_data, scale. = TRUE)
  k <- min(10, ncol(pca_obj$x))
  pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca_obj$x[, 1:k, drop = FALSE])
  names(pca_scores) <- paste0("PCA_", seq_len(k))
  pca_scores <- bind_cols(
      tibble(.rowid = curr_data$.rowid),  # aligns to original rows
      pca_scores
    )

  curr_pca_data <- curr_data %>%
    left_join(pca_scores, by = ".rowid") %>%
    dplyr::select(-all_of(mycols),contains("PCA_"))

  All_PCA_Data[[i]] <- curr_pca_data
  
}

All_PCA_Df_Child <- bind_rows(All_PCA_Data) %>% 
  mutate(Population = "Child")
```


```{r}
Ref_Vars <- c("Child_PID" ,"Study","Mat_PID","Mat_Age","Mat_Edu","Mat_Income", "Max_Edu","Child_Age","Mat_Race","Child_Race","Child_Sex")

mystudies <- unique(Mat_SDOH_Exp$Study)

All_PCA_Data <- list()

for (i in seq_along(mystudies)) {
  
  curr_study <- mystudies[[i]]
  
  curr_data <- Mat_SDOH_Exp %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Study == curr_study) %>% 
    select_if(~ !all(is.na(.))) %>% 
    mutate(.rowid = row_number())
  
  mycols <- names(curr_data)
  mycols <- mycols[!mycols %in% c(Ref_Vars, ".rowid")]
  
  pca_data <- curr_data %>% 
    dplyr::select(all_of(mycols)) %>% 
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    mutate(across(
      everything(),
      ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)
    ))
  
  # Remove columns with zero variance or non-finite SD
  # vapply, not sapply (2026-08-11). sapply() on a zero-column data frame returns
  # list(), and `pca_data[, list(), drop = FALSE]` errors with "must be logical,
  # numeric, or character, not an empty list" -- which fires BEFORE the
  # `if (ncol(pca_data) == 0)` guard immediately below that was meant to catch
  # exactly this case. vapply(..., logical(1)) returns logical(0) instead, which
  # subsets cleanly and lets the guard do its job.
  #
  # This surfaced once a study was left with no usable PCA columns. isTRUE() also
  # guards against sd() returning NA on an all-missing column.
  keep_cols <- vapply(pca_data, function(x) {
    sd_x <- suppressWarnings(stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
    isTRUE(is.finite(sd_x) && sd_x > 0)
  }, logical(1))
  
  pca_data <- pca_data[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Skip study if no usable PCA columns remain
  if (ncol(pca_data) == 0) {
    next
  }
  
  pca_obj <- prcomp(pca_data, scale. = TRUE)
  
  k <- min(10, ncol(pca_obj$x))
  
  pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca_obj$x[, 1:k, drop = FALSE])
  names(pca_scores) <- paste0("PCA_", seq_len(k))
  
  pca_scores <- bind_cols(
    tibble(.rowid = curr_data$.rowid),
    pca_scores
  )
  
  curr_pca_data <- curr_data %>%
    left_join(pca_scores, by = ".rowid") %>%
    dplyr::select(-all_of(mycols), contains("PCA_"))
  
  All_PCA_Data[[curr_study]] <- curr_pca_data
}

All_PCA_Df_Mat <- bind_rows(All_PCA_Data) %>% 
  mutate(Population = "Adult")

```

All_PCA_Df <- bind_rows(All_PCA_Df_Mat,All_PCA_Df_Child)

```{r}

mypal <- paletteer_d("ggsci::default_igv")

Plot_Data <- All_PCA_Df %>% 
  filter(PCA_1 > -3, PCA_1 < 3)

socio_ridge <- ggplot(Plot_Data, aes(x = PCA_1, y = fct_rev(Study), fill = Study)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.85,                   # slightly stronger fill
    scale = 1.1,                    # tighter spacing between ridges
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "white", size = 0.3     # crisp separation lines
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
  labs(
    title = "Within-Study PCA: Distribution of PC1 Scores",
    #subtitle = "Each ridge represents the density of PC1 within a single study",
    x = "PC1 (Study-specific first principal component)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_ridges(center_axis_labels = TRUE, font_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 13, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11, face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

print(socio_ridge)

```


```{r}
study_order <- c(
  "OBSS",
  "ESPINA",
  "CEHC",
  "CCREOH",
  "MARBLES",
  "NHBCS",
  "DAPS",
  "PARENTs",
  "CTS",

  "SLC",
  "EEICC",
  "NYUWHS",
  "TSIC",
  "DEPART",
  "TEDDY",
  "MADRES",
  "GOALS",
  "SEARCH",
  "NASH",
  "THS",
  "ZIP",
  "NFGS",
  "VDAART",
  "MDUC",
  "nuMoM2b",
  "GOC",
  "PROGRESS",
  "DCHS",
  "MEBCO",
  "ELEMENT",
  "VAPS"
)

# study_order is hand-written, and factor(levels = study_order) turns any study
# missing from it into NA, which the filter below then deletes without comment.
# GRAPHS, ATLAA and SWSD were added in 2026-08 and never appended, so they were
# dropped from this figure entirely while appearing everywhere upstream. Append
# whatever is in the data but not in the list, so a new cohort can never again
# disappear silently -- and say so when it happens.
missing_from_order <- setdiff(unique(as.character(All_PCA_Df$Study)), study_order)
if (length(missing_from_order))
  message("Sociodemo_PCA: appending studies absent from study_order: ",
          paste(missing_from_order, collapse = ", "))
study_order <- c(study_order, sort(missing_from_order))

Plot_Data <- All_PCA_Df %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  mutate(
    PCA_Dist = sqrt(rowSums(select(cur_data(), starts_with("PC"))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(PCA_Dist > -10, PCA_Dist < 10) %>%
  mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = study_order)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Study))
stopifnot(dplyr::n_distinct(Plot_Data$Study) == dplyr::n_distinct(All_PCA_Df$Study))

studies_to_box <- c("CCREOH")   # can be c("TEDDY","ZIP") etc.

# y positions after fct_rev()
lvl_rev <- rev(levels(Plot_Data$Study))
y_pos    <- match(studies_to_box, lvl_rev)
highlight_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
  ymin = y_pos - 0.1,
  ymax = y_pos + 0.75
)


summ_socio_ridge <- ggplot(Plot_Data, aes(x = PCA_Dist, y = fct_rev(Study), fill = Study)) +
    geom_rect(
    data = highlight_df,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    fill = "grey95", alpha = 0.6, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.85, scale = 1.1, rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "white", size = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
  labs(
    title = "Within Study Variability",
    #subtitle = "Each ridge shows how far individuals are from their study's PCA centroid (PC1–PC10 combined)",
    x = "Overall Exposure Variability",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_ridges(center_axis_labels = TRUE, font_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size =23, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

save(summ_socio_ridge,file = "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/summ_socio_ridge.RData")
```

  "SICAS"   = "#3D3B25FF",
  "TSIC"    = "#B07AA1FF",
  "USCEHC"  = "#ADE2D0FF",
  "VAPS"    = "#1A5354FF"
)
untarg_studies <- c(
  "CCREOH"  ,
  "DAPS"   ,
  "DEPART" ,
  "ELEMENT",
  "GOC"    ,
  "IMBEDD" ,
  "MDUC"   ,
  "NASH"   ,
  "NHBCS"  ,
  "OBSS"    ,
  "PARENTS" ,
  "SEARCH" ,
  "SICAS"  ,
  "TSIC"   ,
  "USCEHC" ,
  "VAPS"  
)
  
  
study_order <- c(
  "CCREOH"  ,
  "DAPS"   ,
  "DEPART" ,
  "ELEMENT",
  "GOC"    ,
  "IMBEDD" ,
  "MDUC"   ,
  "NASH"   ,
  "NHBCS"  ,
  "OBSS"    ,
  "PARENTS" ,
  "SEARCH" ,
  "SICAS"  ,
  "TSIC"   ,
  "USCEHC" ,
  "VAPS"  
)


Plot_Dat_Untarg_Studies <- Plot_Data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Study %in% untarg_studies) %>% 
    mutate(Study = factor(Study, levels = study_order))


Untarg_Studies_Ridge <- ggplot(Plot_Dat_Untarg_Studies, aes(x = PCA_Dist, y = fct_rev(Study), fill = Study)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    alpha = 0.85, scale = 1.1, rel_min_height = 0.01,
    color = "white", size = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mypal) +
  labs(
    title = "Within Study Variability - Targeted",
    #subtitle = "Each ridge shows how far individuals are from their study's PCA centroid (PC1–PC10 combined)",
    x = "Overall Exposure Variability",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_ridges(center_axis_labels = TRUE, font_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size =23, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey30", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(filename = "../../../Health_Outcome_Analysis/Output/Plots/Targeted_Spread.pdf",plot = Untarg_Studies_Ridge,device = "pdf", height = 8,width = 8)
